title: Upward Technologies opens sign-up for ERIS design partners
content_html:
On 25 September 2026 Upward Technologies announced ERIS and opened sign-up for design partners.

ERIS brings the business tools a company runs on into one system with one login. AI agents work across all modules on the company's own data. Every question and every AI action is logged.

ERIS will run in Upward's cloud or on-premise with local AI models. The beta with design partners starts in November 2026. The official release is in January 2027.

Sign-up for design partners is open on the ERIS product page.
